title: Singleton Pattern
description: Ensure a class has only one instance and provide global access to it.

data.text: The **Singleton Pattern** ensures a class has only one instance and provides a global point of access to it. Useful for logging, configuration, and shared resources.

data.title: Thread-Safe Singleton
Modern Singleton with Lazy<T>
Key Takeaways
points: Use Lazy<T> for thread-safe, lazy initialization
Consider dependency injection as an alternative
data.takeaway: Use Singleton sparingly and prefer DI container singleton registration when possible.
